replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: That'd be pretty chaotic, from what I understand. Would the stone layer separate the two sides, and be impossible to get through with some other method? It's definitely allowed, but I'd worry about the gameplay, since players will most likely blow their teammates up in the process.

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: You cannot limit players to what specific blocks they can and cannot place in a given region. Either prevent them from being able to place blocks, or not. You can, however, prevent the TNT from breaking blocks in certain regions, which might be what you want. Not sure if they still do damage to players, though.
